coverage.limitation: Creation draft, flat preset selection and rules/data-pack navigation do not prove every generator or rule combination.
Conversion and recovery are destructive flows and need dedicated disposable fixtures.
Saved-list management uses disposable loopback entries; server join, authentication and third-party services are not validated.
Horse chest layouts are separate actual fixtures. Crafter does not exist on 1.20.1; other containers do not inherit its toggle semantics.
BookSignScreen is separate only on newer Targets; the older editor signs in place. Front-side sign editing does not prove every side, waxed state or material.
External URL opening is not tested; native confirmation is preserved.
Account/service flows need actual authorization; server-authored dialogs remain pending local UI fixtures, not external-service PASS.

checks.name: title: Native graph and bounded node metadata
world fixture: GUI entry and deterministic Arrange
UI navigation: available font, online and telemetry pages expose actual native controls without changing settings
UI navigation: native credits, win screen and cancel-only external link confirmation
UI navigation: single-biome editor and experiments cancel without creating or replacing a world
UI navigation: actual private game-mode choices hover and commit only on native modifier release
UI owned connection: actual Direct Join reaches ConnectScreen and native Cancel closes its transport
UI owned connection: closing only the owned socket produces actual DisconnectedScreen and a semantic return
UI native confirmation: ten safe acknowledgement, cancel, privacy and permission pages use actual semantic actions
UI native confirmation: legacy native link pages cancel without opening external navigation
UI native confirmation: native Error and OOM pages return safely without inducing errors or exiting the client
UI native confirmation: experimental draft toggle, native Details and cancellation leave private pack selection unchanged
UI recovery: available native disconnected, datapack-failure and aborted pages return through semantic safe buttons; absent classes remain not applicable
UI recovery: available native progress Cancel sets its real cancellation flag before a later-tick return; absent classes remain not applicable
UI recovery: available native graphics warning returns without a fault or settings change; absent classes remain not applicable
UI world recovery: healthy primary and fallback disable Restore; semantic rejection and Back leave only the owned copy touched
UI world recovery: one real optimizer attempt distinguishes native Cancel and joined cleanup from finishing before Cancel
pause: Return to Game is routed, then Save & Quit

notExecuted: real-network multiplayer player-list sorting and 80-player boundary (local packet fixture is separate)
spectator multiplayer category paging and teleport execution
